cost: O(B+N+S) time and output space for rendered text B, N paragraphs, S sentences; context join adds O(context bytes) temporary allocation.
description: F(paras,rule)=rules(rule) + separator + ordered paragraph blocks. Paragraph i receives P(i+1); local sentence k receives [k+1]. Context is emitted iff nonempty and there is no immediate same-document predecessor whose checked successor equals current para. Domain: finite supplied Para references, including all i64 paragraph values; observation: exact rendered UTF-8 bytes.

inverse: Fibers contain Para sequences yielding equal rendered bytes. Book, block, words, dialogue, batch and sentence IDs can vary without effect. Hidden doc identifiers need only preserve adjacent equality decisions; suppressed context may vary while remaining nonempty. Delimiter-free trusted fields permit recovery of rendered title/author/paragraph/text, not omitted metadata.
limitations: Finite synthetic checks only; no teacher/parser/data acquisition.
state: Original paragraph number is displayed but never replaces batch-local P index. Sentence IDs never replace local sentence coordinates. A predecessor in another document cannot suppress context. i64::MAX has no successor.
